method.accounting: Same749/422 full cash calendars, flat days included. Overnight PnL assigned next cash16:00boundary; B to current cash day. Assert non-overlap chronologically; minuteopen/close+knownfill DD with fees atentry. PF per execution in netR, dailyPF in JSON; Sharpe sqrt252 dailymeanR/SD, not accountROI; +quarters from netR cash-boundary attribution.
method.execution: Frozen two_pillar.core.night and price_volume G1_ATR select/execute/marks, unchanged. Entry16:00open to next cash09:30open, stop active fromentry, tick-rounded towardentry, adverse gap open fills. No new stop-distance, clock, target or volume search. All variants one full ATR-normalized position at a time. Rawpoints1NQ/trade; 1.225pt($24.50)RT per executed leg without netting.
method.holding: 16:00open through next actual cash09:30open in SAME contract even if the active indicator route changes at18:00. No rollover transaction/spread PnL, no hindsight switch exclusion, no alternate contract chosen by endpoint availability. Missing same-contract endpoints remain unscored data limitations, not zero PnL.

inference.assumptions: Approximate dependent bootstrap; only36historical/21recent months and potential nonstationarity. Noncircular endpoints underrepresented, explicitly reported. No selected blocklength, no alternative method chosen after seeing pvalues. Raw and adjusted p both reported.
inference.method: Joint moving blocks of two consecutive calendar months within each era, same draws across all5objects. Reuse earlier noncircular block-index scheme and trim to original monthcount; sampled daycount handles unequal/partial months. No block crosses era gap. Combined mean uses fixed original749:422 cash-day era weights.
inference.multiple: 15 PRIMARY tests=5uniquevariants x3periods, Holm15 p-values. Also basic Bonferroni15 simultaneous95% interval set (99.6667%marginal). Duplicate bull-stop label is not a new test. Corrections apply only this round; cannot undo earlier strategy selection or all historical mining.
inference.sensitivity: Complete-day sensitivity reuses identical bootstrap seeds/method as diagnostic. Its nominalCIs are separately identified; not a second confirmatory family or rescue decision. No sensitivity p-values used for promotion.
inference.target: Mean netR per full cash session including zero-position days. Nominal95% BASIC bootstrap CI:observedmean minus97.5/2.5percentiles of centered bootstrap mean errors. Approximate two-sided equal-tail centered-null bootstrap p, plus-one correction. Expected-total-R CI=meanCI times fixed original cash-day count, not uncertainty about already realized PnL.

method.missing: Observed-path stop outcomes conditional on no hidden earlier trigger in missing minutes. Report each pillar incomplete/unknown count. Strict COMMON complete-day sensitivity drops entire cash-boundary day (including B that day) whenever any qualifying bull or originalA night has a missing scheduled minute anywhere in original holdingwindow. Filter by data coverage only, not stop exit or PnL. Excluded days/trades saved privately; no bar filling.
method.preservation: Original consolidated result/report/code and all earlier protected research bytes preserved. B149 unchanged. Previously executable overnight rows must match numerically; only newly admitted same-contract nights can add PnL. No search or independent validation claim.
method.reproduction: Two independent raw CSV source reconstructions with hashes and deterministic byte-identical outputs; inspect future-cutoff contract selection and same-contract endpoints.
method.selection: At09:30 freeze the already effective RTH contract; reconfirm15:55. Only prior-session volume route activations effective before09:30 are allowed. Do not inspect tomorrow route or current finalized futures-session volume. Calendar expiry guard chooses quarterly successor if next cash09:30 is at/after expiry09:30. Guard must be resolved before RTH with matching raw contract features; never patch after entry.
